summary: Hawaiian Electric Industries filed an 8-K disclosing it monetized 30% of its 9.9% stake in American Savings Bank (NYSE: ASBH) via ASB's IPO, selling ~2.0 million shares for $29.5 million net proceeds on September 16, 2026. Underwriters fully exercised a 30-day option for 293,904 additional shares on September 21, adding $4.4 million net. HEI's residual 6.4% stake was worth ~$73.5 million based on ASB's $17.57 September 18 close, subject to a 180-day lockup. Proceeds fund Maui wildfire settlement payments, reducing future capital raises. Watch lockup expiration and any follow-on block sale overhang.
